sentences.en: TopSage.com So, welcome to your introductory geography lecture.
sentences.zh: TopSage.com 那么，欢迎参加你们的地理学导论课。

sentences.en: We'll begin with some basics.
sentences.zh: 我们将从一些基础知识开始。

sentences.en: Firstly, what do we learn by studying geography?
sentences.zh: 首先，通过学习地理学，我们能学到什么？

sentences.en: Well, we learn a great deal about all the processes that have affected and that continue to affect the earth's surface.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们能学到大量关于那些已经影响过、并持续影响着地球表面的各种过程的知识。

sentences.en: But we learn far more than that, because studying geography also informs us about the different kinds of relationships that develop between a particular environment and the people that live there.
sentences.zh: 但我们学到的远不止这些，因为地理学的学习还让我们了解特定环境与居住于其中的人群之间所形成的各种关系。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: We like to think of geography as having two main branches.
sentences.zh: 我们通常将地理学视为拥有两大主要分支。

sentences.en: There's the study of the nature of our planet - its physical features, what it actually looks like - and then there's the study of the ways in which we choose to live and of the impact of those on our planet.
sentences.zh: 其一是对地球本质的研究——即其自然特征、它实际呈现的样貌；其二是对我们选择的生活方式以及这些生活方式对地球所产生影响的研究。

sentences.en: Our current use of carbon fuels is a good example of that.
sentences.zh: 我们当前对碳基燃料的使用就是后者的很好例证。

sentences.en: But there are more specific study areas to consider too, and we'll be looking at each of these in turn throughout this semester.
sentences.zh: 但还有更多更具体的研究领域需要考虑，本学期中我们将依次探讨每一个领域。

sentences.en: These include bio-physical geography, by which I mean the study of the natural environment and all its living things.
sentences.zh: 这些领域包括生物物理地理学，即对自然环境及其所有生物体的研究。

sentences.en: Then there's topography - that looks at the shapes of the land and oceans.
sentences.zh: 然后是地形学——研究陆地与海洋的形态。

sentences.en: There's the study of political geography and social geography too, of course, which is the study of communities of people.
sentences.zh: 当然，还有政治地理学与社会地理学，即对人类社群的研究。

sentences.en: We have economic geography - in which we examine all kinds of resources and their use agriculture, for example.
sentences.zh: 我们还有经济地理学——在该领域中，我们考察各类资源及其利用情况，例如农业。

sentences.en: Next comes historical geography - the understanding of how people and their environments and the ways they interact have changed over a period of a time - and urban geography, an aspect I'm particularly interested in, which takes as its focus the location of cities, the services that those cities provide, and migration of people to and from such cities.
sentences.zh: 接下来是历史地理学——理解人类、其环境以及二者互动方式随时间推移而发生的变化；还有城市地理学，这是我本人特别感兴趣的领域，其关注焦点在于城市的区位、城市所提供的各类服务，以及人口向城市及从城市的迁移。

sentences.en: And lastly, we have cartography.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们还有制图学。

sentences.en: That's the art and science of map- making.
sentences.zh: 即绘制地图的艺术与科学。

sentences.en: You'll be doing a lot of that!
sentences.zh: 你们将大量从事这项工作！

sentences.en: So, to summarise before we continue, we now have our key answer.
sentences.zh: 因此，在继续之前，我们先来做一个小结：我们现在已有了关键答案。

sentences.en: studying this subject is important because without geographical knowledge, we would know very little about our surroundings and we wouldn't be able to identify all the problems that relate to them.
sentences.zh: 学习这门学科之所以重要，是因为若缺乏地理知识，我们将对我们周围环境知之甚少，也无法识别出与之相关的各种问题。

sentences.en: So, by definition, we wouldn't be in an informed position to work out how to solve any of them.
sentences.zh: 因此，按定义而言，我们就无法基于充分信息来思考如何解决其中任何问题。

sentences.en: Okay, now for some practicalities.
sentences.zh: 好的，现在谈些实际内容。

sentences.en: What do geographers actually do?
sentences.zh: 地理学家实际上做些什么？

sentences.en: Well, we collect data to begin with!
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们首先收集数据！

sentences.en: You'll be doing a lot of that on your first field trip!
sentences.zh: 你们在首次野外考察中就会大量开展这项工作！

sentences.en: How do we do this?
sentences.zh: 我们如何做到这一点？

sentences.en: There are several means.
sentences.zh: 方法有多种。

sentences.en: We might, for example, conduct a census - count a population in a given area perhaps.
sentences.zh: 例如，我们可能进行人口普查——或许是在某一特定区域内统计人口数量。

sentences.en: We also need images of the earth's surface which we can produce by means of computer-generation technology or with the help of satellite relays.
sentences.zh: 我们还需要地球表面的图像，这些图像可通过计算机生成技术或借助卫星中继来获取。

sentences.en: We've come a very long way from the early exploration of the world by sailing ships when geographers only had pens and paper at their disposal.
sentences.zh: 与早期地理学家仅靠纸笔、乘帆船探索世界的时代相比，我们已取得了长足进步。

sentences.en: After we've gathered our information, we must analyse it!
sentences.zh: 在收集完信息之后，我们必须对其进行分析！

sentences.en: We need to look for patterns, most commonly those of causes and consequences.
sentences.zh: 我们需要寻找规律，最常见的是因果关系的规律。

sentences.en: This kind of information helps us to predict and resolve problems that could affect the world we live in.
sentences.zh: 这类信息有助于我们预测并解决可能影响我们所生活的世界的种种问题。

sentences.en: But we don't keep all this information confidential.
sentences.zh: 但我们并不会将所有这些信息保密。

sentences.en: We then need to publish our findings so that other people can access it and be informed by it.
sentences.zh: 随后，我们需要发表我们的研究成果，以便他人能够获取并从中获益。

sentences.en: And one way in which this information can be published is in the form of maps.
sentences.zh: 而发布此类信息的一种方式便是以地图的形式。

sentences.en: You'll all have used one at some stage of your life already.
sentences.zh: 你们每个人在人生某个阶段都已使用过地图。

sentences.en: Let's consider the benefits of maps from a geographer's perspective.
sentences.zh: 让我们从地理学家的角度来思考地图的优势。

sentences.en: www.TopSage.com 7. 319 Maps can be folded and put in a pocket and can provide a great store of reference when they're collected into an atlas.
sentences.zh: www.TopSage.com 7. 319 地图可以折叠后放入口袋，在汇编成地图集时，能提供极为丰富的参考资料。

sentences.en: They can depict the physical features of the entire planet if necessary, or, it just a small part of it in much greater detail.
sentences.zh: 它们必要时可展现整个地球的自然特征，也可仅聚焦于其中一小部分，并以更为详尽的方式呈现。

sentences.en: But there is a drawback.
sentences.zh: 但存在一个缺点。

sentences.en: You pSage.com can't exactly replicate something that is three-dimensional, like our planet, on a flat piece of paper, because paper has only two dimensions, and that means there'll always be a certain degree of distortion on a map.
sentences.zh: 你无法在一张平面纸上精确复制像我们地球这样三维的东西，因为纸张只有两个维度，这意味着地图上总会存在一定程度的失真。

sentences.en: It can't be avoided.
sentences.zh: 这是无法避免的。

sentences.en: We can also use aerial photographs .
sentences.zh: 我们还可以使用航空照片。

sentences.en: pictures taken by cameras at high altitude above the earth.
sentences.zh: 即在高空对地球拍摄的照片。

sentences.en: These are great for showing all kinds of geographical features that are not easy to see from the ground.
sentences.zh: 这些照片非常适合展示从地面难以观察到的各种地理特征。

sentences.en: You can easily illustrate areas of diseased trees or how much traffic is on the roads at a given time or information about deep sea beds, for example.
sentences.zh: 例如，你可以轻松地显示病树区域、特定时间道路上的交通流量，或深海海底的信息。

sentences.en: Then there are Landsats.
sentences.zh: 然后是陆地卫星（Landsat）。

sentences.en: These are satellites that circle the earth and transmit visual information to computers at receiving stations.
sentences.zh: 这些是环绕地球运行的卫星，将视觉信息传送到接收站的计算机中。

sentences.en: They circle the earth several times a day and can provide a mass of information - you'll all be familiar with the information they give us about the weather, for example.
sentences.zh: 它们每天绕地球运行数次，可提供大量信息——例如，大家应该都熟悉它们为我们提供的天气信息。

sentences.en: So, what we're going to do now is look at a short presentation in which you'll see all these tools . . .
sentences.zh: 因此，我们现在要观看一段简短的演示，其中你们将看到所有这些工具……
